edition.deck: English is just under the line too, and your American Dream essay draft is due Wednesday.
lead: Good morning, Olivia. Two classes are under 92.5 today. AP Chemistry dropped from 93.4 to 91.8 because Lab 4 is marked missing. Mr. Patel says you can turn it in, or come Thursday from 3:15 to 4:00 to finish it. English is at 92.1 with the Gatsby reading quiz still incomplete.

The rest of the week is busy but doable: Problem Set 6 for Chem tomorrow, the essay draft Wednesday (bring a printed copy, since peer review moved to that day), then the precalc and Spanish quizzes Thursday. And confirm your AP exams before Friday.

dear.headline: Is 92.1 close enough to count as 92.5?
dear.letter: Dear Olivia, I'm four-tenths of a point under the line in English and one missing lab away in Chemistry. My planner says I'm fine. My grade portal says otherwise. Do I trust the planner? It has stickers.
dear.reply: Dear Rounding Up, the portal doesn't care about stickers. Good news: you're closer than it looks. One lab write-up and one reading quiz is maybe ninety minutes of work, and both grades bounce back over the line. Do the lab tonight, the quiz tomorrow, then reward the planner with a sticker. It earned it.
